node.title: KoalaBear m4 adjacency-genus exclusion
node.closure: ordered-adjacency orbital genus calculation plus separable degree-two Riemann-Hurwitz contradiction
node.statement: The unique r=8 outer component for the surviving inner-degree-four route is the connected 120-sheet ordered-adjacency orbital of A6 or S6 on two-subsets. Across the four exhaustive passports its genera are 3, 6, 4, and 13. The actual source normalization has genus at most 3 and maps separably with degree 2 to this orbital component, forcing source genus at least 5, 11, 7, or 25. Thus all four passports and the complete m=4 transverse row are empty; the independent frontier consists of the three m=2 and five m=3 types. No owner charge or prize row close is claimed.
